name: plain
body:
Range("H1:H2").ClearContents
Range("J1").Value = "a"
Range("J2").Value = "b"
Range("J3").Value = "c"
ActiveWorkbook.Names.Add "Target", "=Sheet1!$H$1"
ActiveWorkbook.Names.Add "Choices", "=Sheet1!$J$1:$J$3"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(6, 0, 0, 90, 60)
sh.ControlFormat.ListFillRange = "$J$1:$J$3"
On Error Resume Next
sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "Target"
n = Err.Number
On Error GoTo 0
Report = CStr(n) & "|" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & "|" & sh.ControlFormat.ListFillRange & "|" & _
CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & "|" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.ListCount) & "|" & _
CStr(Range("H1").Value) & "|" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|" & _
CStr(Range("J1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("J2").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("J3").Value)
